# Magento Module Map — Secomm Launchpad

<!-- Generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit -->

> **Purpose**: Map all custom and notable third-party modules. Note which modules have Hyvä compatibility requirements.

---

## Module Discovery

```bash
bin/magento module:status --enabled
ls app/code/
composer show --installed | grep -i hyva
```

---

## Custom Modules

| Module Name | Vendor | Path | Purpose | Risk | Hyvä Compat? | Notes |
|-------------|--------|------|---------|------|--------------|-------|
| Secomm_Base | Secomm | `app/code/Secomm/Base` | Admin menu shell ("Secomm" → "CORE") + "Secomm Extensions" system config tab; helper + plugins | L | Yes | Low-risk shell module |
| Secomm_AddressDropdown | Secomm | `app/code/Secomm/AddressDropdown` | Converts address text fields to AJAX hierarchical dropdowns (country/state/city/sub-city); admin CRUD + import/export; GraphQL schema | M | Yes | Custom GraphQL surface; VN address cascade. Validate end-to-end on every change |
| Secomm_VietNamAddress | Secomm | `app/code/Secomm/VietNamAddress` | Vietnam address data set (VN_Address.csv, VN_Address_2Level.csv) for AddressDropdown | L | Yes | Data-only module |
| Vnpayment_VNPAY | Vnpayment | `app/code/Vnpayment/VNPAY` | VNPAY payment gateway — Pay/Info/IPN controllers, payment.xml/config.xml (default inactive) | H | TBD | HIGH-RISK: payment/IPN/signature. SA review required (Tier 2). Default `active=0` |

## Mageplaza Commerce Suite (source-committed under `app/code/Mageplaza/`)

> **Third-party — do NOT modify in place.** Extend via plugin/preference only. 16 modules.

| Module Name | Path | Purpose | Risk | Hyvä Compat? | Notes |
|-------------|------|---------|------|--------------|-------|
| Mageplaza_Core | `app/code/Mageplaza/Core` | Shared core (feed + update) | M | Yes | `get_update` weekly, `process_feed` hourly |
| Mageplaza_Osc (+ OscPro + OscUltimate) | `app/code/Mageplaza/Osc` | One Step Checkout family | M | Yes | Replaces default checkout. End-to-end QC on every change |
| Mageplaza_SocialLogin (+ Pro) | `app/code/Mageplaza/SocialLogin` | Social sign-in | L | Yes | Provider config [TBD] |
| Mageplaza_Smtp | `app/code/Mageplaza/Smtp` | Transactional email SMTP relay | M | Yes | Daily log-clear cron |
| Mageplaza_GeoIP | `app/code/Mageplaza/GeoIP` | GeoIP lookup | L | Yes | — |
| Mageplaza_ExtraFee | `app/code/Mageplaza/ExtraFee` | Checkout surcharge | M | Yes | Affects checkout totals |
| Mageplaza_DeliveryTime | `app/code/Mageplaza/DeliveryTime` | Checkout delivery-time selection | L | Yes | — |
| Mageplaza_TableRateShipping | `app/code/Mageplaza/TableRateShipping` | Dimensional table-rate carrier (`mptablerate`) | M | Yes | L/W/H factor 5000, default inactive |
| Mageplaza_QuickCart | `app/code/Mageplaza/QuickCart` | Quick cart | L | Yes | — |
| Mageplaza_Lookbook | `app/code/Mageplaza/Lookbook` | Lookbook | L | Yes | — |

| Mageplaza_BackendReindex | `app/code/Mageplaza/BackendReindex` | Backend reindex helper | L | Yes | — |

## Core Module Overrides

| Core Module | Override Type | Custom Module | Purpose |
|-------------|---------------|---------------|---------|
| Magento Checkout | Full replacement (layout) | Mageplaza Osc/OscPro/OscUltimate | One Step Checkout replaces default checkout flow |
| Magento Customer Address (frontend + admin) | Plugin/preference + GraphQL schema | Secomm_AddressDropdown | VN hierarchical address dropdowns (country→state→city→sub-city) |
| Magento Theme (frontend) | Theme fallback chain | Hyva/default → Secomm/launchpad → Secomm/launchpad_fashion | Hyvä theme-fallback + base-layout-reset + compat-module-fallback |

---

> **Hyvä note**: Many core Magento modules have Hyvä compatibility counterparts. Check `composer.json` for `hyva-themes/*` packages before modifying any frontend-related module. Mollie ships a Hyvä compat bundle (3.1.0) — use it rather than hand-rolling payment UI.
